**EMPLOYMENT AGREEMENT**

This Employment Agreement ("Agreement") is made and entered into on this ___ day of __________, 20__, by and between:

**[Employer Name]**, a company incorporated under the laws of India, having its registered office at [Employer Address], Haryana, India 
(hereinafter referred to as the "Employer"),

and

**[Employee Name]**, residing at [Employee Address], Haryana, India 
(hereinafter referred to as the "Employee").

**WHEREAS**, the Employer desires to employ the Employee as an IT Operations Analyst, and the Employee desires to accept such employment, subject to the terms and conditions set forth herein.

NOW, THEREFORE, in consideration of the mutual covenants and promises contained herein, the parties agree as follows:

---

**1. Appointment and Position** 
The Employer hereby appoints the Employee to the position of **IT Operations Analyst**, and the Employee accepts such appointment, effective from **[Start Date]**. The Employee shall perform the duties and responsibilities customary to this role, including but not limited to monitoring IT systems, troubleshooting operational issues, ensuring system reliability, supporting infrastructure upgrades, and complying with internal reporting protocols.

---

**2. Workplace** 
The Employee’s primary place of work shall be **remote**, with performance of duties conducted from a location within Haryana, India, as agreed between the parties. The Employee shall ensure a secure, functional, and professional work environment at the remote location and remain accessible during scheduled working hours. The Employer reserves the right to require occasional in-person attendance at a designated office or facility in Haryana, with reasonable prior notice.

---

**3. Fixed Annual Salary** 
The Employee shall receive a fixed annual salary of **INR 2,175,000 (Indian Rupees Twenty-One Lakh Seventy-Five Thousand Only)**, payable in equal monthly installments in accordance with the Employer’s standard payroll schedule, subject to applicable statutory deductions and withholdings.

---

**4. Probation Period** 
The Employee shall serve a probationary period of **four (4) months**, commencing on the effective date of employment. During this period, either party may terminate the employment with **thirty (30) days’ written notice** or payment in lieu, without further liability, subject to applicable law. Upon satisfactory completion of the probation period, the Employee’s position shall be confirmed in writing by the Employer.

---

**5. Working Time** 
The Employee shall render **thirty-five (35) scheduled hours** of work per week, distributed across five (5) working days. The standard working schedule shall be determined in consultation with the Employer, with flexibility to accommodate operational needs. The Employee shall maintain accurate records of work hours as required by company policy and applicable law.

---

**6. Leave Entitlement** 
The Employee shall be entitled to paid leave in accordance with applicable statutory provisions under the **Haryana Shops and Commercial Establishments Act, 1958**, and other relevant laws, including but not limited to:

- Earned leave as per applicable law 
- Sick leave as per statutory entitlement 
- Casual leave as per statutory requirements 
- Public and festival holidays observed by the Employer

Leave shall be availed with prior approval and in compliance with internal leave procedures.

---

**7. Statutory Benefits** 
The Employee shall be entitled to statutory benefits as mandated under Indian law, including but not limited to:

- Employees’ Provident Fund (EPF) contributions under the Employees’ Provident Funds and Miscellaneous Provisions Act, 1952 
- Employees’ State Insurance (ESI), if applicable based on salary threshold and employee count 
- Gratuity under the Payment of Gratuity Act, 1972, upon completion of eligible service 
- Other benefits as required by applicable labour laws in Haryana and India

The Employer shall comply with all statutory obligations in relation to deductions, contributions, and filings.

---

**8. Confidentiality** 
The Employee shall not, during or after employment, disclose or use any confidential information, trade secrets, technical data, business strategies, or client information obtained during employment, except as necessary to perform duties or as authorized in writing by the Employer. This obligation shall continue after termination of employment to the extent permitted by law.

---

**9. Work-Related Intellectual Property** 
All intellectual property, including but not limited to software code, documentation, system designs, and technical innovations, created by the Employee during the course of employment and relating to the Employer’s business shall be the sole and exclusive property of the Employer. The Employee shall execute any documents necessary to confirm or assign such rights, as required.

---

**10. Workplace Policies** 
The Employee shall comply with all applicable workplace policies, codes of conduct, IT security protocols, and remote work guidelines issued by the Employer from time to time, including those related to data protection, acceptable use of systems, and professional conduct. These policies shall be made available to the Employee in writing.

---

**11. Termination** 
Either party may terminate this employment by providing **seventy-five (75) days’ written notice** to the other party. In the event of termination by the Employer without notice, the Employer shall pay the Employee an amount equivalent to seventy-five (75) days of salary in lieu of notice. Termination shall be subject to compliance with applicable labour laws, including any requirements under the Industrial Disputes Act, 1947, if applicable.

---

**12. Dispute Resolution** 
Any dispute arising out of or in connection with this Agreement shall be subject to the exclusive jurisdiction of the competent courts in Haryana, India. The parties shall make reasonable efforts to resolve disputes amicably through mutual discussion before initiating legal proceedings.

---

**13. Governing Law** 
This Agreement shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of India, including relevant central and state labour legislation applicable in Haryana.

---

**14. Entire Agreement** 
This document constitutes the entire understanding between the parties with respect to the subject matter herein and supersedes all prior discussions, representations, or agreements, whether oral or written.

---

IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the parties have executed this Agreement as of the date first written above.

**For [Employer Name]** 
_________________________ 
Name: 
Designation: 
Date: 

**Employee** 
_________________________ 
[Employee Name] 
Date: 

--- 
*End of Agreement*

This Employment Agreement ("Agreement") is entered into on [DATE], by and between:

**[EMPLOYER NAME]**, a company incorporated under the laws of India, having its registered office at [EMPLOYER ADDRESS], Punjab, India 
(hereinafter referred to as the "Employer")

and

**[EMPLOYEE NAME]**, residing at [EMPLOYEE ADDRESS], Punjab, India 
(hereinafter referred to as the "Employee")

Collectively referred to as the "Parties".

---

**1. APPOINTMENT** 
The Employer hereby appoints the Employee to the position of **Platform Engineer**, and the Employee accepts such appointment, effective from [START DATE], subject to the terms and conditions set forth in this Agreement.

---

**2. DUTIES** 
The Employee shall perform all duties and responsibilities customary to the role of a Platform Engineer, including but not limited to designing, developing, maintaining, and monitoring scalable platform infrastructure, supporting deployment systems, troubleshooting technical issues, and collaborating with development and operations teams. The Employee shall report to the designated supervisor or manager and perform such other lawful duties as may be assigned from time to time.

---

**3. WORKPLACE** 
The Employee’s primary workplace shall be the Employer’s office located in Punjab, India. The Employee shall work under a **hybrid work arrangement**, which permits working from the Employer’s office and remotely, subject to operational requirements and the Employer’s internal policies. The Employee shall be required to attend the office as reasonably directed by the Employer.

---

**4. SALARY** 
The Employee shall receive a fixed annual salary of **INR 1,675,000 (Indian Rupees Sixteen Lakh Seventy-Five Thousand Only)**, payable in equal monthly installments, subject to applicable statutory deductions. The salary shall be reviewed periodically in accordance with the Employer’s policies and applicable law.

---

**5. PROBATION** 
The Employee shall serve a probationary period of **four (4) months** from the date of joining. During this period, the Employer shall assess the Employee’s performance, conduct, and suitability for the role. Upon successful completion of the probation period, the Employee’s appointment shall become regular, subject to the terms of this Agreement. Either party may terminate employment during the probation period with **seven (7) days’ written notice** or pay in lieu thereof.

---

**6. WORKING TIME** 
The Employee shall work **forty (40) scheduled hours per week**, typically distributed over five (5) days. The Employee’s working hours shall be as per the Employer’s standard schedule, unless otherwise adjusted due to operational needs. The Employee may be required to work additional hours as necessary to fulfill job responsibilities, in compliance with applicable labor laws.

---

**7. LEAVE** 
The Employee shall be entitled to paid leave in accordance with the Employer’s leave policy and applicable statutory provisions, including but not limited to earned leave, sick leave, and public holidays observed in Punjab. The accrual and availing of leave shall be subject to the rules and procedures established by the Employer and applicable law.

---

**8. STATUTORY BENEFITS** 
The Employee shall be entitled to benefits as required under applicable Indian labor laws, including but not limited to: 
- Employees’ Provident Fund (EPF) and Employees’ Pension Scheme (EPS) under the Employees’ Provident Funds and Miscellaneous Provisions Act, 1952 
- Employees’ State Insurance (ESI), if applicable 
- Gratuity under the Payment of Gratuity Act, 1972, upon completion of eligible service 
- Maternity benefits under the Maternity Benefit (Amendment) Act, 2017, if applicable 
All statutory contributions shall be made by the Employer as per statutory rates and procedures.

---

**9. CONFIDENTIALITY** 
The Employee shall not, during or after employment, disclose or use any confidential information, trade secrets, technical data, business strategies, or proprietary information of the Employer, except as required in the course of employment or as permitted by law. This obligation shall continue after termination of employment.

---

**10. WORK-RELATED INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY** 
All intellectual property, including but not limited to software, code, designs, documentation, and inventions, created by the Employee during the course of employment and related to the Employer’s business shall be the sole and exclusive property of the Employer. The Employee shall execute all necessary documents to confirm such ownership, as required.

---

**11. WORKPLACE POLICY** 
The Employee shall comply with all lawful policies, codes of conduct, safety norms, and procedures established by the Employer, including those related to data security, remote work, anti-harassment, and professional behavior. The Employer reserves the right to update such policies from time to time.

---

**12. TERMINATION** 
This employment may be terminated by either party by providing **thirty (30) days’ prior written notice** or payment of salary in lieu of the notice period. The Employer reserves the right to terminate employment immediately for cause, including misconduct, breach of policy, or violation of law, in accordance with applicable procedures. Upon termination, the Employee shall return all company property and documents.

---

**13. DISPUTE RESOLUTION** 
Any dispute arising out of or in connection with this Agreement shall be resolved amicably through mutual discussion. If unresolved, the dispute shall be subject to the jurisdiction of the competent courts in Punjab, India, in accordance with applicable law.

---

**14. GOVERNING LAW** 
This Agreement shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of India. All terms and conditions are subject to applicable statutory requirements and regulatory provisions.

---

**15. ENTIRE AGREEMENT** 
This document constitutes the entire understanding between the Parties with respect to the employment of the Employee and supersedes all prior discussions, representations, or agreements, whether oral or written.

---

IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the Parties have executed this Agreement as of the date first written above.

**[EMPLOYER NAME]** 
By: _________________________ 
Name: [AUTHORIZED SIGNATORY NAME] 
Title: [DESIGNATION] 
Date: [DATE] 

**[EMPLOYEE NAME]** 
Signature: ___________________

Date: [DATE] 

---
